title: John Ramirez on human-alien hybrid programs

tellings.quote:
GS15 and he's come out now and I think
on your show as well saying that like
he's sure we have hybrid programs, human
alien hybrid programs.

plain: A former CIA officer named John Ramirez, who reached GS-15, one of the top grades in the US civil service, has said publicly that he is sure the United States runs programmes breeding human and alien hybrids. Jesse Michels repeats this, saying Ramirez has come forward with it, and mentions it alongside Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who led a small office studying unexplained aerial reports.
